constraints: Tern 0.9.2 has no plugin-defined Preferences settings schema; execution and profile options are per command.
Profiles default On, including YAML that omits profiles. Startup is noninteractive login: interactive-only rc files or guarded sections are not executed.
Shell names resolve through the execution process PATH, then standard installation directories; command env is applied after startup and cannot change shell lookup.
zsh system /etc/zshenv cannot be disabled by -f; explicit profiles, scripts and wrappers remain trusted code.
fish always uses --private; native shell scripts are not translated between POSIX and fish syntax.
Background completion callbacks are lost if the originating window/plugin VM is unloaded.
Tab execution starts the helper directly, retains output until Enter acknowledgement, and does not inject commands into the parent shell.
Tern snapshots palette rows on opening; reopen after an in-flight configuration refresh.
Tern tree text is capped at 200 characters; smoke uses plugins expect for full input values and compares saved scripts exactly.
The native environment editor is single-line; literal multiline environment values are covered through YAML/helper execution tests.

Bun 1.3.14 fs/promises.realpath on this macOS returned ENOENT for an existing directory containing a literal backslash. Cwd cases cover spaces, quotes and Unicode; backslash and newline preservation are covered in environment values.
Delete writes YAML immediately and refreshes palette actions; Undo restores only the deleted node and its settings/comments, not a previous document snapshot.
Deletion history is an in-memory LIFO stack owned by one manager. Tab switching and same-project Reload retain it; closing/reopening, resolved-project changes, plugin reload and restart discard it.
Undo uses the current configuration revision and refuses duplicate IDs without consuming history; Reload permits retry after external edits or resolution of an ID conflict.
List Cmd/Ctrl+Z undoes deletion; form Cmd/Ctrl+Z remains text-editor undo. No persistent trash or Redo is implemented.
